title: Forward QA Agents — Field Guide
eyebrow: Plates 44 and 45 of the field guide
footer: Forward QA Agents · two agents an organisation can drop into its own environment · the [process page](process.html) explains the engagement they belong to.
heroH1: Two agents that land in a stranger's environment and leave working test infrastructure behind.
heroLead: Plate 44 points a real browser at a running web app, records what is broken, and provisions a Playwright + Playwright MCP project.
Plate 45 reads whatever legacy tests exist (Selenium in any language, Cucumber, Postman, test plans) and rebuilds them as one Playwright architecture.
Both run to completion with no model at all; a local open-weight model only polishes text.
primerP: One folder under `src/agents/`, one CLI, a few REST routes, one `node:test` suite per agent.
Every deliverable exists with `LLM_PROVIDER=none`: crawl, findings, generated project, report.
One SQLite database (`engagements`, `runs`, `findings`, `artifacts`), so every number traces to a run id.
The adapter only talks to a model you run yourself; public endpoints are rejected.

stats.lbl: Tests, all green with no model
